result.instructions: Tools for Motion, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tasks are due this week in my Motion workspace?"; "Create a high-priority task called 'Send the Q4 report' due Friday at 17:00."; "Which projects are in my workspace, and what is their status?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Motion data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run motion_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run motion_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run motion_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. motion_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: motion_get_my_user
tools.title: Get my user
tools.description: Get the owner of the API key: id, name and email. Good first call to confirm which Motion account is connected. Motion API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: motion_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this user belongs to, with their statuses and labels. Use the workspace ids in the other tools. Motion API: GET /v1/workspaces.

cursor.description: Cursor from meta.nextCursor of the previous call, to get the next page.

tools.name: motion_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects in one workspace, with status and custom field values. First call motion_list_workspaces and pass its workspace id; listing projects without a workspace is not supported. Motion API: GET /v1/projects.

cursor.description: Cursor from meta.nextCursor of the previous call, to get the next page.

tools.name: motion_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, filtered by workspace, project, assignee, label or name. Completed tasks are left out unless includeAllStatuses is true. Motion API: GET /v1/tasks.

workspaceId.description: Limit results to one workspace id (from motion_list_workspaces).

projectId.description: Limit results to one project id.

assigneeId.description: Limit results to one assignee user id.

label.description: Limit results to tasks with this label name.

name.description: Limit results to tasks whose name contains this text (not case-sensitive).

includeAllStatuses.description: Include tasks in every status, not only the open ones.

cursor.description: Cursor from meta.nextCursor of the previous call, to get the next page.

tools.name: motion_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by id: name, description, due date, duration, status, project, assignee and completion time. Motion API: GET /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: motion_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task in a workspace. Writes to the Motion account: it adds a new task each time it runs, so call it once per task. Motion API: POST /v1/tasks.

workspaceId.description: The workspace id the task belongs to (from motion_list_workspaces).

dueDate.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-30T17:00:00Z.

duration.description: Minutes as a whole number above 0, or NONE, or REMINDER.

status.description: Status name. Defaults to the workspace default status.

deadlineType.description: Deadline type. Motion defaults to SOFT.

projectId.description: The project id the task belongs to.

assigneeId.description: The user id the task is assigned to.

labels.description: Label names to add to the task.

tools.name: motion_get_schedules
tools.title: Get schedules
tools.description: Get the working schedules of this user: the weekly hours and timezone for each schedule. Motion API: GET /v1/schedules.
